jackittome.configuration.title: JackItToMe Settings
jackittome.configuration.showRecipeButto: Show the jack button on recipes, in whichever recipe viewer you use. Turn it off to pull only with the keybinds — the G keys, autocrafting and the hover tooltip keep working. The button already hides itself when there is nothing to pull from, i.e. when a recipe is opened with only your own inventory behind it.
jackittome.configuration.buttonOffsetX.t: REI only. Moves the recipe button horizontally, in GUI pixels; positive moves it right. JEI is unaffected, as it positions its own recipe buttons.
jackittome.configuration.buttonOffsetY.t: REI only. Moves the recipe button vertically, in GUI pixels; positive moves it down.
jackittome.configuration.placementKeys.t: REI only. While enabled, open any recipe and press Ctrl + the arrow keys to move the jack button; Ctrl+Home puts it back. The position is saved automatically, so you can switch this off again once it looks right.

key.jackittome.pull_override: Pull in-stock override (hold + click recipe button)
